stages.hypothesis: Make prediction-to-trade conversion explicitly cost-aware rather than optimizing direction alone.
stages.changes: Next candidate must forecast return magnitude and trade only when expected edge exceeds realistic round-trip friction plus safety margin. Current 26 bps assumption retained for conservative testing.

stages.hypothesis: Regime gating can suppress trades during volatility/liquidity states where the signal is unstable.
stages.changes: Add causal volatility/trend regime features; train/evaluate gates without using future regime labels. Require per-regime OOS reporting.

stages.hypothesis: Separate direction forecasting from entry/execution timing.
stages.changes: Slow model produces expected-return/direction; fast model only decides enter/wait/veto. Avoid treating candle micro-proxy as historical Level-2 truth.

stages.hypothesis: Cross-market and derivatives context may add orthogonal information.
stages.changes: Candidate feature set: ETH/BTC relative momentum, perpetual funding, basis, open-interest change and liquidations when public historical data is legally available; features must be timestamp-aligned and lagged.

stages.hypothesis: Robust validation is more important than threshold search.
stages.changes: Require purged/embargoed walk-forward or nested walk-forward, untouched final OOS, realistic fees/slippage, minimum trade count, PF/average-net/DD gates, and stability across folds/regimes. No promotion from the current proxy replay.

key_points: 2026 BTC ML walk-forward research reports naive sign strategies collapse after costs; cost-aware execution filtering sharply reduces turnover and can restore selected strategies.
2026 Journal of Financial Markets research supports order flow as relevant to cryptocurrency returns, reinforcing collection of genuine historical microstructure rather than candle proxies.
Backtest-overfitting research supports explicit rejection of agents/candidates that do not survive unseen periods.
external_research_synthesis.next_architecture: Hourly expected-return model (tree/regularized ensemble) + cost-aware no-trade zone + causal regime gate + separate genuine microstructure execution gate; derivatives/cross-market features added only after timestamp-clean historical pipeline exists.

next_work: Implement and test the cost-aware expected-return architecture on a longer historical sample with nested walk-forward; then add regime and derivatives features by ablation.
